svg.aria-label: Memory write path: the assistant reply and its outbox job commit in one transaction; a worker claims the job with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, holds a 90 second lease across the LLM call, and writes an idempotent Store value.

svg.text: How one turn becomes durable memory

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The row lock covers only the claim. The lease covers the work — including the call that leaves the database.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A crashed worker lets the lease lapse and another worker takes over; its stale token can no longer complete the job.
